source.label: FY2025 Form 20-F, Item 6.C, number of registered shareholders
source.quote: As at December 31, 2025, Novartis AG had approximately 184 000 registered shareholders.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM's separate bond rows for Novartis Capital Corp and Novartis Finance SA are not counted. CalPERS: its Form 13F information table for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no Novartis shares or ADRs (searched by name), so calpers is null. Holders of record: approximate number of shareholders in the Share Register at December 31, 2025 (rounded by Novartis); the 20-F says registered shareholders represent about 56.0% of issued shares, so total holders are more.
